Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onramp proposal — BioClinic pilot terms

Sara — thanks again for the demo today. As discussed, attached is the starter term sheet for the 3-month onramp pilot:

- 35% onboarding credit (applied first month)
- 20% unit price discount for first 90 days
- Dedicated support hours: 20 included; option to purchase add-ons
- Standard Redwood hosted SLA; premium SLA is an add-on

We believe this structure keeps unit economics reasonable while letting BioClinic validate model fit at scale. Quick asks: can you confirm the primary region will be eu-west-1 and confirm the two team emails for the Legal review? If you’re good, I can send the DocuSign envelope and get signature.

Attached: Commercial_Term_Sheet.pdf (term sheet)

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart

Redwood Inference | developer-first inference platform
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@bioclinic.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BioClinic Legal <legal@bioclinic.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Onramp proposal — BioClinic pilot terms

Evelyn — thanks, this looks close to what we discussed. A couple of items from our side before we can sign: 

1) Can you extend the onboarding credits to cover the first 6 weeks instead of a one-time month application? That helps with our phased rollout.
2) We need a day-zero SLA credit if you can't meet the premium SLA during our ramp (equivalent to 5% ARR credit cap if uptime < 99.5% in month 1).
3) For procurement, BioClinic will require a separate schedule for data residency and audit logs; legal has forwarded the memo.

If Redwood can accommodate the credit framing above we can proceed to signature this week.

Best,
Sara Patel
Head of Data Products, BioClinic Health
+44 20 7946 0123

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Onramp proposal — BioClinic pilot terms | Exec approval requested

Marissa — looping you in for an exec signoff. BioClinic is strategically important: they operate in the EU and are acquiring a small provider that would make Redwood the standard inference provider across their platform if the pilot goes well. High-level commercial ask from the customer (see thread below):

- Change onboarding credit application to cover first 6 weeks vs a single month (effectively shifts how we amortize the 35% credit)
- Day-zero SLA credit clause: up to 5% ARR credit cap if uptime < 99.5% in month 1
- Legal wants an explicit data residency schedule and audit-log retention appendix (they will send redlines)

Why I recommend approving the exception:
- Estimated first-year ARR (if converted): $1.2M ARR; pilot expected to convert to expanded POC within 90 days
- Strategic channel: wins us a reference in EU regulated healthcare; increases chance of marketplace listing for region-specific deployment
- We can limit exposure by attaching a capped credit (5% ARR cap) and a hard end date (90 days)

Attached: exec_memo_RDW-01.pdf (one-page business case + cost exposure calc)

Proposed approval language we can put in the amendment if you’re OK: 
- Approve: onboarding credit to be applied pro-rata across first 6 weeks of pilot; SLA credit clause limited to a 5% ARR cap and single-month trigger; data residency appendix to be negotiated separately and to include KMS requirements.

If you approve, I’ll issue an amended term sheet and route to DocuSign. Karthik, Jonas — please prepare the exact amended line items for the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Evelyn Hart
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onramp proposal — BioClinic pilot terms | Exec approval requested

Thanks for the clear memo, Evelyn. Approve with conditions: 

1) Onboarding credit: permit pro-rata application across the first 6 weeks, but cap the effective dollar exposure to the equivalent of a single month of list credit (finance to confirm exact dollar cap).
2) SLA credit: I’m comfortable with a single-month, tiered credit with a hard 5% ARR cap as you proposed. Add explicit measurement window and remediation steps in the schedule.
3) Data residency appendix: Legal + Security to handle; insist on KMS integration and SOC2 evidence.

Karthik — please prepare the dollar cap math and updated term sheet. Jonas — prep DocuSign with the amended schedule and include a short cover letter highlighting the limited exposure and strategic rationale. Evelyn, get this back to Sara this afternoon with a clear cover note.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial (Americas & EMEA), Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0122
